Dou Shou Qi (斗兽棋 / Jungle)

Animals battle across rivers and traps to reach the enemy den. Move your 8 ranked animal pieces (Rat to Elephant) toward the opponent's Den. Higher rank captures lower, but the Rat defeats the Elephant. Traps weaken defenders, rivers block most pieces.

1 Variants
chess Plugin
✓ Frontmatter-only

Declared, Not Coded

Every rule of Dou Shou Qi (斗兽棋 / Jungle) below is frontmatter in the rules corpus, played by the chess plugin. The board beside each is the game itself, live.

Dou Shou Qi (Standard) Rules

Move your 8 ranked animal pieces (Rat to Elephant) toward the opponent's Den. Higher rank captures lower, but the Rat defeats the Elephant. Traps weaken defenders, rivers block most pieces.

engine:
  topology:
    type: grid
    rows: 9
    cols: 7
  players: [white, black]
  plugin: chess
  plugins:
    dou-shou-qi:
      castling: false
      enPassant: false
      noCheck: true
      stalemateMeaning: loss
      regions:
        water:
          cells:
            - [3, 1]
            - [3, 2]
            - [3, 4]
            - [3, 5]
            - [4, 1]
            - [4, 2]
            - [4, 4]
            - [4, 5]
            - [5, 1]
            - [5, 2]
  # …
